scripts.dev: concurrently -n WEB,API -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @supermarket/web" "npm run dev -w @supermarket/api"
scripts.cdk:aws:synth: npm run build:lambda && cdk synth --app "npx ts-node --project infra/tsconfig.json infra/bin/aws-api.ts"
scripts.cdk:aws:deploy: npm run build:lambda && cdk deploy --app "npx ts-node --project infra/tsconfig.json infra/bin/aws-api.ts" --require-approval never
scripts.cdk:local:synth: npm run build:lambda && cdklocal synth --app "npx ts-node --project infra/tsconfig.json infra/bin/localstack-api.ts"
scripts.cdk:local:deploy: npm run build:lambda && cdklocal deploy --app "npx ts-node --project infra/tsconfig.json infra/bin/localstack-api.ts" --require-approval never
